parameters.name: Envs
parameters.description:
The environment to which you want to publish the code.

> - production: The name of the production environment. It includes SpecName (environment name) and AllowedHosts (domain name whitelist).
>
> - presetCanary: Optional. The grayscale environment that you can add as needed.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the Edge Routine. The name must be unique within an Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: SelectCodeRevision
parameters.description: The version of the Edge Routine (ER) code to publish.
